acceptanceCriteria: cockpit-release 提供 version-consistency 类型化命令，校验 workspace cockpit-cli 版本、所有本地 workspace package 版本、当前三语发布/架构/版本文档及 operations 基线，失败时返回非零并给出明确规则错误。
tests/release/version_consistency.sh 保留 post-release 的公共 Release 稳定性、tag、manifest 和资产命名校验，但源版本一致性规则由 cockpit-release 执行。
现有版本一致性静态门禁、Rust cockpit-release 测试和当前仓库版本一致性命令全部通过；不改变 adopter black-box acceptance。
goal: 减少 Rust、Shell、jq 之间的版本身份规则重复，使版本一致性失败在单一类型化实现中可诊断、可测试、可复用。
intent: 将当前版本一致性身份校验的事实和规则集中到 cockpit-release Rust，保留 Shell 仅作参数/外部发布工具编排；保持 post-release 公共 Release 检查和黑盒安装验收边界不变。
outOfScope: 不迁移 adopter_acceptance.sh 的黑盒安装/升级执行、隔离根清理、外部 GitHub API 调用或 phase receipt 生命周期；不修改公开 Release、不改变版本号、不删除历史兼容代码、不新增 crate。

scenarioCoverage.expected: The Rust command detects an ambiguous cockpit-cli package, a local workspace version mismatch, a malformed semantic version, or a stale required document with a rule-specific failure.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused cockpit-release tests with temporary repositories and execute the current repository version-consistency command.

scenarioCoverage.expected: version_consistency.sh delegates source identity checks to cockpit-release while retaining only command-line/environment setup and post-release gh/jq checks.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the wrapper, run its static policy test, and run the source-only path against the current repository.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The change does not alter adopter black-box installation, isolated roots, release downloads, or phase receipt recovery.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Review the diff boundary and run the existing release script static checks without invoking a public Release mutation.

scope: 修改 crates/cockpit-release/src/main.rs、crates/cockpit-release/src/lib.rs、tests/release/version_consistency.sh、tests/release/version_consistency_test.sh，并新增 crates/cockpit-release/src/version_consistency.rs 与对应测试；实现源版本一致性规则的 Rust SSOT，让 Shell 调用该命令并继续负责 post-release 的 gh/curl/jq 外部检查。
sources: 用户 2026-09-22 架构复核：发布逻辑按职责迁移，身份校验优先统一到 Rust，保留独立黑盒安装验收。
